verdict.rationale: Notion's own docs say the REST API can 'read, create, and update nearly everything in a workspace': pages, databases, users and comments. The API surface is broad, with webhooks, Agent session and management APIs, an OpenAPI spec and an official MCP server that can create pages and databases. However, the vendor's own 'nearly' wording concedes that UI parity is incomplete, and nothing in the pack shows which UI features are unavailable. Missing for 10: a documented API-to-UI parity matrix showing every UI action is available via API, explicit coverage of areas such as delete and admin/settings operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: With the REST API, you can read, create, and update nearly everything in a workspace — pages, databases, users, comments, and more.
